title: AI4IA Foundry A2A exposure manifest
description: Declares a deployed Foundry agent to expose over the Agent2Agent (A2A) protocol and front through APIM (see docs/foundry-toolbox.md P7 and https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/foundry/agents/how-to/enable-agent-to-agent-endpoint). scripts/provision-foundry-a2a.py reads this file, prints the APIM-fronted consumer URL, emits the enable + APIM-front commands, and prints an agents.json AgentSpec stub for the app's links (agent-as-tool) seam. A2A is Azure public preview.

agentName.description: Name of the deployed Foundry agent to expose over A2A (its endpoint is minted when A2A is enabled).

displayName.description: Human-readable name shown in the app's @-menu when the remote agent is registered.

description.description: What the remote agent does (helps routing/delegation).

linkAs.description: Local catalog agent name to register the remote A2A agent as, so other agents can delegate to it via their `links`. Lowercase slug.
